primary_hypothesis: Fixed exponential exposure scoring is noninferior to frozen spike-mixture scoring within10percent relative extra edges atN300 across32fresh disjoint banks.
primary_effect: R=sum(exponential extra edges)/sum(spike extra edges)-1, paired across32banks.
primary_interval: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of32banks,RNG20261207. Percentile95percent interval. Supported if upper<=.10; falsified if lower>.10; otherwise inconclusive. A zero denominator in the full statistic or any bootstrap draw makes the primary inconclusive, with no discarded draws.
uncertainty_limit: 32fixed disjoint banks from the official finite dataset, one fixed tie stream perbank. Approximate bank bootstrap; no population-universal acquisition guarantee.
policies: Candidate and spike dispatch to the unchanged spike_policy.py and online_policy.py. After m jointly observed unequal labels with no equality: candidate1/(1+m), spike2u/(1+u), exponentialu, where u=(8/9)^m. All weights zero after any observed equality, diagonal zero. Exponential ablates the mixture denominator while preserving fixed rate1/9. Same maximal-degree first cell, greedy summed weight thereafter, and permutation tie rule. No rate, margin, query-count or optimizer tuning.
rng: For bank s in0..31, NumPy2.3.4 default_rng(20261125+s).permutation(81) once per row, shared across policies. Shadowcurrent-row permutations RNG20261225+s. This is unchanged tie logic; banks0..5 reuse prior tie seeds but have wholly new raw boards.
acquisition_interface: Policy receives only past joint/equal counts, k=25 and tie order. It has no file access, row solutions, current values, source identifiers, geometry or oracle handle. The harness fixes and records the mask before revealing only its25 queried values. Full stored completions act solely as the simulated label oracle.
gates: All current-row masks finalize before reveal; premature reveal rejected. State unchanged by selection. For every row/policy, permuting hidden current-row values leaves the finalized mask identical. Observed files contain values only at selected cells. Independent recount of all prefix supports and exact25-query count.
secondary: Candidate is an additional unchanged control. Evaluate all96N300policy/seed cells on freshfull-all[190000,200000), fixed short-budget search. Accuracy contrasts spike-candidate,exponential-candidate,exponential-spike use paired two-way bootstrap95percent intervals,5000draws,RNG20261208,descriptive and unadjusted.
budget: At most30GPU-minutes, including bounded preflight/validation. CPU acquisition and overlapping preparation/search are eligible; no filler GPU work.
limitations: Active acquisition is simulated from stored complete boards; the policy itself sees only queried labels.
25 queries per board fixes label cost. Policies can expose different digits from the same current row, then learn from their different histories.
Adaptive masks are not independent uniform draws, so the previous independent-mask coverage theorem does not directly apply.
BP AdamW is outside this count-energy acquisition mechanism study and is not run.
The exponential and mixture scores are heuristics; their model assumptions are not asserted to hold for Sudoku.
relation_to_prior: Separate prospective ablation excluding all prior clues, online-confirmation and spike source rows. Preserve earlier studies separately; do not pool outcomes.
stopping_rule: Exactly32freshbanks of300boards,threepolicies and96inference cells, except exact-model/settings deduplication. No adaptive extension or hyperparameter changes.
heuristic_scope: Exponential and spike-mixture scores are declared acquisition heuristics, not calibrated posterior guarantees for Sudoku or adaptive data.
